command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null; LINE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])shizuku_server$' | head -n1 || true); echo shizuku_server_line="$LINE"; printf '%s' "$LINE" | grep -Eq '^shell[[:space:]]+'; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK"
